say:3:1010605001:0.text: Look, Magister! Those fallen rocks seem to be hiding something!
say:3:1010605001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看那些落石后面！好像挡着什么东西的样子！
say:3:1010605001:0.male: Look, Magister! Those fallen rocks seem to be hiding something!
say:3:1010605001:0.female: Look, Magister! Those fallen rocks seem to be hiding something!

say:4:1010605002:0.text: The tunnel looks like it was dug by hand, but there's no way in. The entrance must have caved in during the battle just now.
say:4:1010605002:0.source_cn: 有人工开凿的痕迹，看起来是条通道。不过已经无法通行了，...

say:5:1010605003:0.text: Wow... I can't even hear the sound of wind passing through. This tunnel's been completely warded off.
say:5:1010605003:0.source_cn: 唔……连空气流通的风声都听不见，应该是堵得结结实实了。

say:6:1010605004:0.text: Guess we'll just have to go around, then.

say:7:1010605005:0.text: It looks like Miss Mirael was pointing us towards the Heights north of Ryeham.
say:7:1010605005:0.source_cn: 看刚才米瑞尔小姐指的方向，是金穗村以北的高地。

say:8:1010605006:0.text: I know a path to get there. Follow me.
say:8:1010605006:0.source_cn: 我知道有条小路通向那里，跟我来。
